scope: Exploratory validation diagnosis. No outer test and no checkpoint changes.

candidates.hypothesis: Real source episodes supplied directly as labelled context may improve transfer over target-only context.
candidates.selection: One whole query CPT per eligible fold-training site. Choose the episode nearest in support count to the requested budget; resolve episode and query ID ties using seed-20261014 SHA-256 hashes. No label- or evaluation-score-based retrieval.
candidates.target_context: All currently revealed CPTs with whole-location/coincident-location leave-out features.
candidates.limitations: Small source sites can lack a requested support count; each selected source count is recorded. Equal site rows do not guarantee source relevance or remove negative transfer.

candidates.hypothesis: One shared revealed anchor set for context and query features may reduce construction mismatch.
candidates.anchor_rule: ceil(0.6*m), minimum2, maximumm-1 anchors. Start nearest the revealed-set centroid then use geometry maximin; stable location ID order breaks ties.
candidates.context: Non-anchor revealed CPT labels. Their features and unseen query features both use only the same anchor observations.
candidates.limitations: This is not a cost-free pure shift intervention. There are fewer target label-context rows and fewer observations per query feature. Every revealed CPT contributes either an anchor or labelled context.

shared_controls.root_evaluation: All60 v0.2 maximin validation states:3folds x2sites x2seeds x5budgets

raw_feature_shift.scope: Six archived diagnostic states:fold0, LowerHutt and Tauranga, seed17, budgets5/9/13. Not all60 states.
raw_feature_shift.support_count: Standard labelled context hasm-1 versus querym; honest context/query both have the same anchor count.
raw_feature_shift.nearest_neighbor_distance: At budget5 for both examined sites,100 percent of query rows have nearest-neighbor normalized distances outside the standard context range. Query distances are smaller on average.
raw_feature_shift.interpretation_limit: Raw construction shift only. Constant support_count may be removed by official preprocessing. Neither causal failure nor a Transformer architectural limitation is established.

information_boundaries.source: Only explicit train-role episodes within this fold's training sites. Source query labels are training evidence, never target evaluation query labels.
information_boundaries.target: Only condition(observed) supplies target labels. Query features strip measurement columns. Anchor selection uses revealed geometry only.
information_boundaries.provenance: Every bank records fold, sites, investigation groups, episode IDs, exact support/query IDs and depth IDs. Each condition exposes context_manifest.

effective_protocol.explanation: Separate local factory preserves pinned official V2 settings without the older target-only study guard. Predictor copies config and explicitly sets target_context_only=false for source_bank, true for honest.
effective_protocol.root_logging_recommendation: Save each predictor.context_manifest under its state key. Do not report the inherited v0.2 target-only flag as the effective source-bank protocol.

tests.coverage: Source role/fold boundaries, equal-site rows, deterministic save/load, source/target exclusion, anchor label-feature separation, ignored query truth.

official_sources.supports: Pinned public fit(X,y), predict(output_type=full), and version-specific V2 initialization.
Official V2 selection and full predictive distribution. Does not claim source-context mixing improves CPT.
